rows.fullStatement: FR-501: Every query, job, proposal, integration, and command MUST carry a tenant and its applicable entity/branch scope, resolved against live membership rather than client-supplied actor or role claims.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete genuine scoped/foreign/branch and access-loss cases for every query, job, proposal, integration and command; 500 process/forecast reads with two sessions cover only those reads.

rows.fullStatement: FR-503: Each metric MUST require its analytics capability, entitlement, and every underlying source permission; lost access MUST invalidate displayed evidence and prevent saved-result reopen or drill-through.
rows.remainingEvidence: Verify live source permission/entitlement revocation for all metrics and saved-result creation/reopen/drill-through, including immediate protected display clearing.
rows.candidateImprovement: Settled model output now rechecks current source authority after settlement and before returning evidence. Native clearing and every other projection still need genuine actor evidence.

rows.fullStatement: FR-504: Analytics projections MUST exclude private HR, credentials, payment details, unrestricted audit payloads, and raw free-text reasons by default; authorized private data MUST require a separately reviewed projection.
rows.remainingEvidence: Inspect every analytics projection, exported payload and prompt against the prohibited-field list; limited metadata and process wire-shape checks do not cover all projections.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-501: Every tenant-bearing base table MUST enable and force RLS; every new view/RPC/job/export MUST pass foreign-ID, cross-tenant, cross-branch, source-permission-loss, and anonymous-denial cases with zero leaked results.
rows.remainingEvidence: Installed metadata checks cover forced RLS/grants, but every new view/RPC/job/export still needs all anonymous/foreign/branch/source-revocation zero-leak behavior cases.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-507: Secret/PII checks of client binaries, exports, prompts and logs MUST find zero prohibited fields; access-revocation tests MUST clear visible evidence before another protected read or action is possible.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete zero-prohibited-field scans of Connected binary, exports, actual prompts and logs plus native access-revocation display clearing before another protected action.
rows.candidateImprovement: Settled model output now rechecks current source authority after settlement and before returning evidence. Native clearing and every other projection still need genuine actor evidence.

rows.fullStatement: AC-501: Scoped source access (FR-501, FR-503, FR-504, NFR-501, NFR-507) Given permitted and forbidden identities across two tenants and branches When a metric, job, drill-through, or saved result is requested and access changes Then only currently permitted projections are returned and protected evidence is cleared.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete permitted/forbidden two-tenant/branch metric/job/detail/saved-result behavior before/after access changes and immediate visible evidence clearing.
rows.candidateImprovement: Settled model output now rechecks current source authority after settlement and before returning evidence. Native clearing and every other projection still need genuine actor evidence.

rows.fullStatement: EC-501: Tenant/entity/branch mismatch or permission loss during a running job causes denial/cleared evidence, including report download; verify with AC-501.
rows.remainingEvidence: Exercise live tenant/entity/branch mismatch and permission loss during active jobs, including report download and cleared native evidence.
rows.candidateImprovement: Settled model output now rechecks current source authority after settlement and before returning evidence. Native clearing and every other projection still need genuine actor evidence.

rows.fullStatement: FR-557: The source adapter MUST require existing `analytics.view`, `workflow.process.view`, the proposed `analytics` entitlement, and the allowlisted source-domain permission in the requested entity/branch, and MUST revalidate permitted source detail before drill-through.
rows.remainingEvidence: Exercise installed analytics/workflow/source capability, entitlement, tenant/entity/branch and current drill-through permission cases through genuine actors.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-553: Every adapter MUST pass anonymous, foreign tenant/entity/branch, own-event-without-source-permission, revoked access, and missing entitlement cases with zero protected rows or aggregate leakage.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete all genuine anonymous/foreign/own-event-without-source-permission/revocation/missing-entitlement zero-leak adapter cases.

rows.fullStatement: AC-554: Source permission is stronger than own-event visibility (FR-557, NFR-553) Given an event actor who lacks the underlying source-domain read permission When an aggregate or drill-through is requested with otherwise valid IDs Then neither the event projection nor its metric value is returned.
rows.remainingEvidence: Use a genuine own-event actor lacking source-domain permission and prove zero event/aggregate/detail output from the installed adapter.

rows.fullStatement: EC-556: Null entity source, mismatched branch, foreign IDs, own-event RLS visibility, hidden source domain or capability loss does not grant analytics access; covered by AC-554/558.
rows.remainingEvidence: Domain foreign/null scopes reject correctly; genuine own-event RLS/source permission/capability loss adapter cases remain incomplete.

rows.fullStatement: FR-516: AI retrieval MUST use an allowlist of scoped read tools and redact disallowed fields before any provider invocation; retrieved text MUST not grant permissions, choose tools, or override the application policy.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete the reviewed private retrieval/provider path with genuine scoped evidence, malicious source text and field redaction before actual invocation; no model invocation occurred.
rows.candidateImprovement: Untrusted model adapters are rejected before retrieval; saved outcomes are validated before usage settlement. Controlled regression evidence only; actual provider/actor/settlement checks remain.

rows.fullStatement: FR-517: An AI action MUST first create an immutable proposal revision containing its allowlisted command, target revisions, parameter hash, evidence references, explanation, expiry, and estimated resource budget.
rows.remainingEvidence: Read back genuine immutable proposals with exact allowlisted command, target versions/hash, evidence, explanation, expiry and budget; verify edit/revision behavior.

rows.fullStatement: FR-518: Proposal approval MUST be an explicit online human decision bound to that exact revision/hash; a distinct approver with the required capability and MFA MUST approve a material mutation, and any edit MUST invalidate approval.
rows.remainingEvidence: Exercise genuine distinct proposer/approver sessions and MFA, self-approval denial, exact revision approval, edit invalidation and downgrade/expiry rejection.

rows.fullStatement: FR-519: Execution MUST recheck approval, expiry, live source revisions, scope, permissions, entitlement, and limits, then invoke the existing business command once; AI MUST not run arbitrary SQL or bypass its posting checks.
rows.remainingEvidence: Run approved execution through existing business command checks with stale/expired/revoked targets and overlapping genuine executor requests.

rows.fullStatement: FR-520: AI quota reservations and usage settlement MUST be recorded by a trusted worker using a unique invocation identity; provider retries and uncertain completion MUST not silently double-charge usage or execute twice.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete trusted worker invocation reservation/usage settlement, retries and unknown outcome reconciliation; the private model key and actual usage remain absent.
rows.candidateImprovement: Untrusted model adapters are rejected before retrieval; saved outcomes are validated before usage settlement. Controlled regression evidence only; actual provider/actor/settlement checks remain.

rows.fullStatement: AC-507: Scoped AI retrieval (FR-516, NFR-507) Given malicious source text, private fields, and an unconfigured model provider When scoped retrieval and a model request are attempted Then only allowlisted redacted evidence is eligible and absent providers do not fabricate output.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete installed scoped retrieval/malicious text/private field and absent-provider attempts; full private coordinator/redaction behavior remains incomplete.
rows.candidateImprovement: Untrusted model adapters are rejected before retrieval; saved outcomes are validated before usage settlement. Controlled regression evidence only; actual provider/actor/settlement checks remain.

rows.fullStatement: AC-508: Approval binds the proposed action (FR-517, FR-518) Given a proposal with target versions, expiry and exact parameter hash When the proposer self-approves, another user approves, or an approved revision is edited Then self-approval is denied and only the unchanged separately approved revision is executable.
rows.remainingEvidence: Run genuine self-approval denial, distinct required-MFA approval and approved-revision edit invalidation through the installed workflow.

rows.fullStatement: AC-509: Safe execution and AI usage (FR-502, FR-519, FR-520, NFR-506) Given an approved proposal, retries, uncertain provider completion, and a stale target When overlapping execution requests occur Then the existing business command validates live state and creates at most one effect/usage settlement.
rows.remainingEvidence: Run stale and overlapping genuine approved execution plus retries/unknown provider completion, reconciling exactly one business effect and usage settlement.
rows.candidateImprovement: Untrusted model adapters are rejected before retrieval; saved outcomes are validated before usage settlement. Controlled regression evidence only; actual provider/actor/settlement checks remain.

rows.fullStatement: EC-507: Retrieved prompt injection, unavailable model, exhausted quota, or unknown provider outcome cannot authorize execution; verify with AC-507/509.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete real reviewed retrieval injection/provider-unavailable/quota/unknown-outcome policy boundaries; no genuine model output or settlement exists.
rows.candidateImprovement: Untrusted model adapters are rejected before retrieval; saved outcomes are validated before usage settlement. Controlled regression evidence only; actual provider/actor/settlement checks remain.

rows.fullStatement: EC-508: Approval expires, proposer equals approver, target changes, or MFA assurance drops; deny execution and retain proposal/decision; verify with AC-508/509.
rows.remainingEvidence: Complete genuine expiry/self-approval/stale-target/MFA-downgrade execution denials with retained proposal and decision evidence.

rows.fullStatement: FR-527: Operator dashboards MUST expose only a separately authorized operational projection; a tenant owner role MUST not grant cross-tenant operator access, and business rows MUST remain outside default health views.
rows.remainingEvidence: Use the separate genuine MFA operator identity to verify owner denial, cross-tenant isolation and only reviewed health projections.

rows.fullStatement: FR-528: Operator access to a selected tenant MUST require an explicit reasoned, expiring, MFA-protected access grant with immutable access audit; service-role credentials MUST remain absent from the desktop application.
rows.remainingEvidence: Issue the exact reviewed expiring/reasoned operator authority and prove MFA access plus immutable audits and expiry/revocation; scan Connected binary for service secrets.

rows.fullStatement: FR-529: Operator health MUST show bounded worker lag, retry/dead-letter counts, quota states, and contract readiness with generation timestamps; missing probes MUST be labelled unknown and MUST not imply healthy delivery.
rows.remainingEvidence: Observe installed worker lag/retries/dead-letter/quota/readiness timestamps and missing-probe unknown states using real authorized operator reads.

rows.fullStatement: AC-514: Operator isolation (FR-527, FR-528, FR-529, NFR-501, NFR-507) Given a tenant owner, an operator and an expiring tenant-access grant When each opens health or tenant evidence Then only permitted projections appear and unknown probes remain unknown with audited access.
rows.remainingEvidence: Run genuine tenant-owner/operator/grant expiry cases with authorized projections, audit and stopped-probe unknown readiness.

rows.fullStatement: EC-512: Operator grant expires mid-read or health probes stop reporting; deny tenant evidence and display unknown readiness; verify with AC-514.
rows.remainingEvidence: Exercise real operator grant expiry mid-read and stopped health probes with access denial and unknown readiness.
